# UmaLytics 0.5.1

## Fixes and improvements

- **Casual rooms:** every player stays visible when joining or rejoining long-lived rooms. Internal IDs never appear as names; players without a Discord account show "Profile unavailable".
- **History links:** click a match code in a player's history to open it in the History tab, with a link to Uma Drafter.
- **Players:** the page shows the season name, and ratings are consistent throughout UmaLytics.
- **Team icons:** tooltips no longer cover other rows or cards.
- **Lobby cards:** long W-L records no longer stretch the layout.
- **Draft:** columns line up and race conditions stay on one line.
- **Copy diagnostics:** includes an anonymous room-event summary for bug reports.

## Update

Download and extract the ZIP for your browser. Disable the previous extension, load the new build, reopen UmaLytics and refresh your drafter tabs. Confirm **v0.5.1** in the header.

The Chromium ZIP supports Chrome, Edge, Brave and Opera GX. Firefox / LibreWolf uses an unsigned temporary add-on, which must be loaded again after a browser restart. SHA256SUMS.txt contains optional download integrity checksums.

Automated regression, type and build checks passed before release; they do not replace live installed-browser testing.
